capabilities: Paste Logos references as formatted quote blocks with BibTeX metadata and block IDs
Create and update linked reference notes with YAML frontmatter citation data
Generate bibliographies in LaTeX/BibTeX, MLA, APA, or Chicago format
Export all references to a single .bib file
Clean stale citation backlinks from reference notes
disambiguation: Not a general-purpose citation manager; it only ingests references copied from Logos Bible Software in BibTeX citation style.
extras: Logos must be configured to use BibTeX citation style before the plugin works; reference metadata is designed to be compatible with Obsidian properties, Dataview, and the Bases plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture citations from Logos Bible Software, so quoting sources and building bibliographies must be done manually.

relations.evidence: simplifies referencing and linking material from Logos Bible Software

summary: Citation plugin that pastes references copied from Logos Bible Software as BibTeX-backed quote blocks and generates bibliographies.
